build_mobilenetv2_backbone: build a MobileNetV2 backbone with default widen factor for semantic segmentation
build_mobilenetv2_custom_width: build a MobileNetV2 backbone with a custom widen factor to adjust channel width
run_mobilenetv2_forward: run the MobileNetV2 forward pass on an input tensor to extract feature maps
freeze_mobilenetv2_stages: freeze the first N stages of MobileNetV2 backbone parameters for transfer learning
review_mobilenetv2_arch_settings: review the MobileNetV2 arch settings to understand expand ratio, channels, and block counts
